feed.title: dark_websites — a reference database of the useful, lesser-known web
feed.subtitle: New finds from the dark_websites reference database.

entry.title: SomaFM
entry.summary: Listener-supported, commercial-free internet radio with dozens of hand-curated channels. (niche)

entry.title: Rosetta Code
entry.summary: The same programming task solved side by side in hundreds of languages. A comparative reference. (niche, deep)

entry.title: Radio Garden
entry.summary: Spin a globe and drop into any live local radio station on Earth. Wonderfully meditative. (kitsch, niche)

entry.title: Poetry Foundation
entry.summary: A vast, searchable archive of poems and poets, plus essays and a daily poem. (broad, deep)

entry.title: Openverse
entry.summary: Search across hundreds of millions of openly-licensed images and audio you can reuse freely. (broad, narrow)

entry.title: Old Maps Online
entry.summary: Search historical maps from libraries worldwide by place and time. A gateway to cartographic archives. (niche, deep)

entry.title: Are.na
entry.summary: A calm, ad-free tool for collecting and connecting ideas, images and links into visual research channels. (niche, deep)

entry.title: Open Library
entry.summary: An open, editable catalogue aiming for one web page per book ever published, with many free to borrow. (broad, deep)

entry.title: Kagi Small Web
entry.summary: A live stream of fresh posts from independent blogs and personal sites — the non-algorithmic web. (obscure, niche)

entry.title: 1MB Club
entry.summary: A directory of websites that weigh less than one megabyte — a quiet protest against the bloated web. (niche, kitsch)

entry.title: Wikenigma
entry.summary: An encyclopedia of the unknown — a catalogue of gaps in human knowledge and unanswered questions. (obscure, niche)

entry.title: Freesound
entry.summary: A huge collaborative database of Creative Commons sound clips — field recordings, effects, loops. (niche, broad)

entry.title: RefSeek
entry.summary: An academic search engine for students and researchers, indexing documents, encyclopedias and journals. (broad, deep)

entry.title: Neocities
entry.summary: Free static web hosting reviving the spirit of GeoCities. Browse a directory of hand-made personal sites. (kitsch, obscure)

entry.title: BASE
entry.summary: Bielefeld Academic Search Engine — one of the largest indexes of open-access scholarly material on the web. (deep, broad)

entry.title: neal.fun
entry.summary: A collection of playful interactive toys and visual experiments — 'The Size of Space', 'Deep Sea' and more. (kitsch, niche)

entry.title: The Pudding
entry.summary: Visual essays that explain ideas debated in culture through data, animation and interaction. (niche, deep)

entry.title: Everything2
entry.summary: A pre-Wikipedia collaborative writing community — part encyclopedia, part literary playground, still alive. (obscure, kitsch)

entry.title: TV Tropes
entry.summary: A vast, hyperlinked wiki cataloguing storytelling devices across every medium. Easy to lose an afternoon. (broad, deep, kitsch)

entry.title: DevDocs
entry.summary: Fast, searchable, offline-capable API documentation for hundreds of languages and libraries in one place. (broad, deep)

entry.title: Can I use
entry.summary: Browser support tables for HTML, CSS and JS features. The reference for what's safe to ship. (narrow, niche)

entry.title: regex101
entry.summary: Build and debug regular expressions with live highlighting and a plain-English explanation of each token. (narrow, broad)

entry.title: explainshell
entry.summary: Paste a shell command and it annotates every flag and argument with the matching man-page text. (narrow, niche)

entry.title: CyberChef
entry.summary: The 'cyber swiss-army knife' — encode, decode, encrypt, parse and analyze data by stacking operations. (narrow, deep)

entry.title: Shapecatcher
entry.summary: Draw a symbol with your mouse and it finds the matching Unicode character. (narrow, niche)
